features.label: Exclusive miami j select compatibility
features.text: Designed specifically to fit the straps of the Ossur Miami J Select cervical collar. This universal 10-pack accessory ensures you have plenty of tabs for your entire recovery period, though please note they are not compatible with standard Miami J models.

features.label: Consistent clinical positioning
features.text: Take the guesswork out of reapplying your neck brace. These reproducible fit tabs create a reliable contact point on your collar straps, allowing you to maintain the exact fit prescribed by your medical professional every single time.

features.label: Independent donning and doffing
features.text: Regain your independence during cervical recovery. By acting as a built-in strap guide, these tabs make it significantly easier for patients to properly secure and remove their own brace without needing constant assistance.

features.label: Streamlined tab installation
features.text: Setting up your repeatable fit system is quick and straightforward. Once your collar straps have been properly trimmed, simply thread the strap end through the tab and attach it securely to the integrated molded hook.

measurement: Universal one-size fit. Includes 10 tabs per pack. Fits all Miami J Select collar straps after trimming. Perfect Fit Promise
